list_events.description: Find natural events NASA is tracking, such as wildfires, storms, volcanic eruptions, floods and icebergs. Filter by category, source, open or closed, the last few days or a date range, an area on the map, and size (wind speed, burned area...). Each event comes with its latest position and magnitude, every dated position, and a one-line summary.
